method: Source PDF SHA-256 verified; fresh pdfplumber extraction of PDF pages 39 and 40 matched persisted raw text; both full pages visually inspected at 110 DPI; columns, year headers, units and footnotes checked. The source is a fiscal-2024 filing. Page 4 distinguishes expectations from historical/current facts and says forward-looking statements are not guarantees. Fiscal-2026 realized net sales cannot be established from this corpus. Keep unsupported; a forecast or prior-year result is not the requested fact.

The requested September 11, 2026 closing price postdates this filing. Historical stock performance on page 23 and price-volatility discussion on page 20 cannot establish that later daily close. Keep unsupported; requires an external market source.

The sole Vision Pro text-search match was page 4. Do not substitute aggregate revenue. These checks support provisional abstention but do not prove exhaustive absence; retain the draft unsupported label pending broader review.

No exact unit sales phrase was found, but phrase absence cannot prove the count is undisclosed. Do not infer units from revenue or a guessed selling price; retain provisional unsupported status pending broader review.

Page 4 says forward-looking statements are not guarantees; page 8 warns against using historical financial trends to anticipate future results; page 20 discusses stock volatility; page 23 says past price performance is not necessarily indicative of future performance.
